exposure: Maternal biologic therapies (infliximab, adalimumab, vedolizumab, ustekinumab) in the third trimester
outcome: Infant immune system function (complete blood count, differential, immunoglobulin levels, extended B-cell and T-cell subset enumeration, Recent Thymic Emigrants, regulatory T-cell numbers, mitogen stimulation assays, T-cell Receptor Excision Circles)
Rotavirus vaccine-specific adverse effects following immunizations
cohort: 57 infants born to 52 mothers with inflammatory bowel disease who received biologic therapies in the third trimester.
finding: Immune function testing was normal, and administration of live rotavirus vaccination appeared low-risk in biologic-exposed infants irrespective of circulating drug levels.
followup_time: At least up to 42 days after the last rotavirus vaccine dose (first dose administered at a median of 13 weeks of age); immune assessments and drug concentrations were measured at a median of 10.7 weeks of age (range, 9.4-12.4 weeks).
gest_age: Median of 39 weeks (interquartile range, 38-39 weeks) at delivery
